card.text: Explore Tuttle's inferred contact-body model from Hubble and Spitzer observations.

introduction.text: Tuttle’s nucleus is thought to have two touching lobes. Hubble, Spitzer and Arecibo observations give different estimates of their shape and size.

model.title: Hubble-derived contact model scaled by Spitzer measurements.
model.summary: Two touching spheres fitted to Hubble and Spitzer observations. This shape fits the thermal measurements better. Surface detail is unknown; the rotation phase is illustrative.

arecibo.title: Alternative contact-body model fitted to Arecibo radar observations.
arecibo.summary: Two elongated lobes fitted to radar echoes. Their axes are aligned with the other model for comparison. Surface detail is unknown; the orientation is illustrative.
